faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Here are some frequently asked questions about Crochyll:
faq.reponse1: Crochyll is a platform for selling handmade products as well as a platform for reading and creating crochet patterns.
faq.question2: What is the delivery time for my order?
faq.reponse2: Delivery time depends on your location and the time required to prepare your order. You will receive a confirmation email once your order has been started, with a more precise delivery time, and another shipping confirmation email containing tracking information.
faq.reponse3: Yes, you can return an item within 7 days of receiving your order, provided the item is in the same condition as when you received it. Please contact our customer support for return instructions.
faq.question4: Do I need a PayPal account?
faq.reponse4: No, this is not mandatory; card payment works. To do so, you must select the 'credit card' option during checkout.
